items.title: File Klage against rejection of advertising-sign building permit
items.quote: Klage gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe vor dem Verwaltungsgericht Musterkirchen (Domplatz 4, 45879 Musterkirchen) erhoben werden; ein Vorverfahren ist nicht vorgesehen (§ 110 JustG NRW).
items.computation: The letter's own date in the Bescheid text is 28.07.2027 (earlier than the 30.07.2027 printed in the letterhead; the earlier date is used as it gives the earliest plausible, safest deadline). As a postal letter from a German administrative authority, it is deemed delivered 4 days after posting under § 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG NRW, i.e. Sun 01.08.2027; for this type of letter the day does not shift even though it is a Sunday. The one-month Klage period under § 110 JustG NRW starts the next day (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB) and ends one month later, on Wed 01.09.2027 (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB). 01.09.2027 is a working day in NRW, so no further shift is needed. If instead the later letterhead date (30.07.2027) is the actual posting day, the deadline would fall a few days later, around 03.09.2027 (since 01.09 would already be the deemed-delivery day) — so the safe, earliest date to rely on is 01.09.2027.

warnings: The letter gives two different dates for itself: the letterhead "Datum" field says 30.07.2027, while the body text says "mit diesem Bescheid vom 28.07.2027" — the earlier date (28.07.2027) was used to compute the Klage deadline as the safer, earliest plausible reading; if the actual posting date was 30.07.2027 or later, the true deadline could fall a few days later than 01.09.2027, so the recipient should not rely on the extra days and should file well before 01.09.2027.

The Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung states no Widerspruchsverfahren applies (§ 110 JustG NRW) — Klage must be filed directly with the Verwaltungsgericht Musterkirchen, not an objection with the authority itself.
